answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 18909 Country: India Title: I performed an Istikhara on the seeking guidance to marry my cousin whom i feel is a pious person. In the first dream i saw Myself and her in a car which was being driven very fast. Question: Dear Ulemas, I am a 23 year old man doing his MBA from Srinagar, kashmir. I performed an Istikhara on the seeking guidance to marry my cousin whom i feel is a pious person. In the first dream i saw Myself and her in a car which was being driven very fast. Both of us were laughing very heartily but i don't remember who was the driver. We passed through various areas of the city. However, in some places i saw some black men throwing bricks at us. but these could not do any damage to us or the car. In the second dream, I saw her in a truck and she was fully clad in a white dress, which looked like a Thobe(JUBBA) or something. The truck was moving by itself. Could you please interpret? Answer ID: 18909 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 113/108=H=1431) If there is no hindrance in performing nikah, you should go for it in Islamic way. The dream indicates to the same result which was sought in the istikharah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
